title: UFO: Unfair-to-Fair Evolving Mitigates Unfairness in LLM-based Recommender Systems via Self-Play Fine-tuning
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any benchmarks related to faith or religion. The focus is on item-side unfairness in recommender systems, measured by comparing the distribution of recommended items to their historical distribution across groups defined by popularity, genre, and title length.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this topic was not a part of its investigation. The research is focused on mitigating item-side unfairness in recommender systems.
